verdict.rationale: incident.io documents incident declaration from Slack and Microsoft Teams, auto-started Teams meetings, and GitHub PR updates with follow-ups exported as GitHub Issues that sync changes. A changelog entry describes two-way ticket sync, where the ticket updates the incident and the incident updates the ticket, though it does not say which ticketing tool. missing for 10: explicit Jira integration evidence, any Zoom integration, documented bidirectional state flow for Slack/Teams, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, the platform integrates with the tools around the incident — Jira, Slack, Teams, Zoom, GitHub — so state flows both ways

citations.quote: you can do it right from where your team already works, whether that's Slack or Microsoft Teams
Automatically start a Microsoft Teams meeting for each incident.
Connect pull requests and get updates in your incident channel. Export follow-ups as GitHub Issues and we'll sync any changes.
You can now configure incident tickets to update the incident when the ticket changes, as well as updating the ticket when the incident changes.
